channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Landry Shamet | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Landry Shamet from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Brown on Landry Shamet
item.description:
Mike Brown:

“Ithought Mitch Robinson was huge for us … in both directions. And then Landry Shamet; Landry hasn’t played a drop in the playoffs … and he was huge on both ends of the floor.”

Mike Brown on Landry Shamet, May 8, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Josh Hart on Landry Shamet
item.description:
“Depending on where you get drafted to, it can take two, three or four years, especially if you don’t have a good vet. With how things are shaking out now, there’s a lot less vets on teams to hold guys accountable. It’s (rarer) now, and (Shamet) is a great example of that.”

Josh Hart on Landry Shamet, Feb 18, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Mike Brown on Landry Shamet
item.description:
Knicks coach Mike Brown said.

“And he definitely took [Shamet’s] left arm and I had a great view of it, and I’m glad the official did, and more importantly I’m glad he made the right call.”

Mike Brown on Landry Shamet, Nov 20, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Landry Shamet, Miles McBride
item.description:
Still, the reserves enjoyed an uptick in production recently with Robinson and Shamet getting comfortable.

“We’ve started the season with Landry hurt and Deuce [McBride] not 100 percent. So our wings did play more,”

Tom Thibodeau on Landry Shamet, Miles McBride, Mar 13, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Landry Shamet
item.description:
James Edwards III:Tom Thibodeau on Landry Shamet's return:

“I watched the game last night. We had a number of guys play well. It was encouraging to see him out there.”

Tom Thibodeau on Landry Shamet, Dec 17, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Landry Shamet
item.description:
“I don’t make the final decision on that, but I’m basing it on what [Shamet’s] done on the floor. He’s really done well,”

Tom Thibodeau on Landry Shamet, Oct 5, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mat Ishbia on Landry Shamet
item.description:
“I want to thank Chris and Landry for all of their contributions to the team's success in recent years,”

Mat Ishbia on Landry Shamet, Jun 24, 2023. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Monty Williams on Landry Shamet
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty Williams on Landry Shamet:

“It's two-fold for him. Two sides of the ball. His defense allows for us to not have to put Book on the main guy every possession,and then on the other end, the execution vs. double-teams and taking and making shots speaks to his mentality.”

Monty Williams on Landry Shamet, May 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Desmond Bane on JJ Redick, Ben Simmons, Landry Shamet
item.description:
“Obviously the attention that Ben Simmons and (Joel) Embiid demand is huge, so guys like me are very valuable that can play off the ball and make shots, have similar success to JJ Redick and Landry Shamet in previous years, running off screens. I feel like I can provide some of those same things.”

Desmond Bane on JJ Redick, Ben Simmons, Landry Shamet, Oct 8, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Marcus Morris, Landry Shamet
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard on Marcus Morris & Landry Shamet adjusting to a fully healthy team:

“I think they're doing good. They just didn't knock down shots today. It's just one of those days. They had good looks, just didn't knock them down.”

Kawhi Leonard on Marcus Morris, Landry Shamet, Mar 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @Farbod_E.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Wilson Chandler, Landry Shamet
item.description:
“We are excited to welcome Wilson, Mike, and Landry to the L.A. Clippers. Wilson is a veteran player we have long respected for his toughness, versatility and leadership. His hard-nosed mentality will fit right in with the rest of this group,”

Lawrence Frank on Wilson Chandler, Landry Shamet, Feb 6, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Wilson Chandler, Landry Shamet
item.description:
Frank continued,

“We have also admired Landry, a first round pick from Wichita State, since last year’s draft process. He has only justified expectations. Landry quickly earned a spot in the 76ers rotation and has been the most accurate three-point shooter in this year’s rookie class. In addition to Wilson, Mike, and Landry, we obtained multiple draft assets today that will be important building blocks as we continue to carry out our long-term plan -- to construct a sustainable championship contender.”

Lawrence Frank on Wilson Chandler, Landry Shamet, Feb 6, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Brett Brown on Landry Shamet
item.description:
Sixers'Brett Brown on Landry Shamet:

“He’s quietly jumping into this league ... He lets me coach him and he’s prideful. In the capacity that we’re using him, as a mini-J.J.,I’m running stuff for him as a rookie. We’re putting him situations, and he’s responded. He’s delivered.”

Brett Brown on Landry Shamet, Nov 3, 2018. Source: Twitter @JeffZillgitt.

item.title: Kevin Young on Landry Shamet
item.description:
#Sixers assistant Kevin Young on rookie PG @Landry Shamet’s summer-league role:

“I think for this, we are going to try to use him a little bit more off the ball. We will give him run at the 1. Primarily, he’ll be off the ball.”

Kevin Young on Landry Shamet, Jul 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.
